messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: High 5xx error rate detected for customer CobaltBridge (dedicated-eu). Alert triggered: 2026-03-17T08:12:24Z. Sampling: /v1/embeddings (p95 latency up, 5xx spike). Paging on-call.

maria: oncall here. seeing ~22% 5xx for cb-eu-prod on prometheus. impact concentrated on embedding endpoint only. digging logs now.

aj: I can take lead on mitigation. is there a recent deploy to that pool?

maria: last deploy 2026-03-17T07:45 by infra-deploy-bot (rollout v2.3.1). No config changes reported since. Heatmap shows tokenization learner timeouts around same window.

kevin: I'm checking autoscaler and GPU nodes. No node restarts but kube-proxy logs show some conntrack errors. Could be networking flakiness between routers and dedicated pool.

tara: paging account team (cc @jonah) — CobaltBridge is high-touch enterprise with active SSO/finance workflows. We need tailored customer notify + status page copy. Also confirm contact routing to their incident ops contact list.

jonah: on it. their on-call list: operations@cobaltbridge.com, dave@cobaltbridge.com (primary), pager: +1-555-0199. Will escalate per SLA after 30 mins if no resolution. Do we have suggested workaround to include?

aj: mitigation plan: 1) failover traffic to fallback model variant (cb-embed-v1-small) for requests from CobaltBridge while we triage 2) enable 4xx/5xx circuit breaker to reduce retries 3) scale dedicated pool temporarily. Can we route just their traffic?

maria: yes, smart-routing can pin customer->variant. I'll create a canary routing rule now. Command:

```
POST /routing/policies
{
  "match": {"customer_id":"cobaltbridge"},
  "route_to":"cb-embed-v1-small",
  "priority":1000
}
```

maria: applied. routing change pushed, waiting 60s for propagation. monitoring.

kevin: started a manual scale +2 GPUs on cb-eu-prod. watching for node-level errors. If networking persists, will add iptables prune on the host. ETA 3m.

incident-bot: Routing change applied. Traffic steering to cb-embed-v1-small for customer_id=cobaltbridge. Metric check window starts now.

maria: immediate 5xx rate for CobaltBridge dropped from 22% -> 6% after steering. Deployed circuit breaker to reduce retries. Continuing to monitor.

tara: draft status page / customer-notify below — please sanity-check and approve. This will be sent from support@redwood.ai and posted to status.redwood.ai under HIGH priority.

lisa: suggested edits incoming.

tara: STATUS PAGE (DRAFT):\n\nSummary: We are investigating elevated errors impacting embeddings for CobaltBridge's dedicated EU environment. A mitigation has been applied to route CobaltBridge traffic to a compatible fallback model to restore service while we investigate root cause.\n\nImpact: Customers may have experienced failed embedding requests (5xx) and higher latency between ~07:10–08:10 UTC. CobaltBridge traffic is currently operating on the fallback model with degraded throughput but restored success rates.\n\nWhat we're doing: We have applied routing changes, enabled circuit breakers, and temporarily scaled their dedicated pool. Our infrastructure and networking teams are investigating root cause in parallel.\n\nCustomer-specific note: If your application relies on strict model parity for embeddings, you may observe small embedding vector differences. We are preserving request ordering and keys. For urgent concerns, contact operations@cobaltbridge.com or Redwood account manager (jonah@redwood.ai).\n\nETA: Investigation ongoing. Next update in 30 minutes or when we have a clear remediation path.\n\nNice-to-have: link to status incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/7252223344

jonah: looks good. add sentence: "We will not perform any data migrations or delete data as part of mitigation." Also include the SLA note that we escalated per contract.

tara: updated with that line. Final -> ready to send to CobaltBridge ops contact list. Who will send?

jonah: I'll send tailored email and paste thread into their ticketing system. Draft email below — please sign off.

jonah: EMAIL DRAFT TO COBALTBRIDGE OPS:

Hi Dave / CobaltBridge Ops,

We detected elevated 5xx errors affecting your dedicated EU embeddings environment early this morning. We have applied a temporary routing change to a compatible fallback model to restore request success rates and scaled your reserved pool while we investigate. You may see slight differences in embeddings; correctness checks should be performed if you have downstream ML jobs.

What we did: routing -> cb-embed-v1-small; enabled retry/circuit breakers; scaled +2 GPUs. No data migration or deletion.

Next steps: Our infra and networking teams are investigating a potential connection handling regression introduced by a recent kube-proxy kernel update. We will provide a further update in 30 minutes. If you need immediate escalation, reply to this thread or call +1-555-0199.

Apologies for the disruption — Jonah (Redwood Engineering, jonah@redwood.ai)

lisa: minor wording tweak: change "kube-proxy kernel update" -> "kube-proxy conntrack behavior after kernel patch". Otherwise good.

jonah: updated and sent to operations@cobaltbridge.com and dave@cobaltbridge.com. Ticket created: CB-INC-2042. Marking customer-notified.

maria: monitoring shows error rate steady at ~4% for CobaltBridge; global load healthy. Continuing to trace logs for root cause. If networking churn reduces, we'll plan rollback to original variant.

kevin: found one host with high conntrack table drops. I patched iptables prune and restarted kube-proxy on that node. No restarted pods. Observability shows steady recovery.

maria: good spot. Let's keep the routing rule for 1 hour then attempt controlled rollback. If rollback fails, we'll keep fallback and do deep analysis.

tara: On-call handoff note: @aj will remain primary until 09:00 UTC, then hand off to @maria for monitoring and postmortem. Please update the incident channel when handing off.

aj: acknowledged. leaving a short runbook entry for follow up: "Collect kernel conntrack stats, kube-proxy version, iptables entries, and host-level network metrics. Create RCA template and link to ticket CB-INC-2042." I'll also schedule the postmortem meeting.

maria: confirmed. next update in 30m or on rollback attempt. Closing temporary paging but keeping channel open for updates. :white_check_mark:
